high_level_description: The image features a stylized portrait of a person with dark skin tone, wearing a bright pink wig and a blue dress with puffed sleeves. The individual is holding a bouquet of orange flowers in one hand, which is placed on a yellow stand. The background is a solid light pink color, giving the image a vibrant and somewhat surreal feel. Below the portrait, there is a black text box containing white text that reads: "Artist who painted official portrait of Michelle Obama cancels major Smithsonian exhibition, citing censorship.
